title: GrainElectricalCheckResponse
description: Grain -> RepairOS: the result of POST /projects/{id}/electrical/check, and the `electrical` member of a /call response. Two lists with no index between them today: readings[] (one row per reading that named a net; a reading with no net yields only a finding) and findings[]. Pinned against the private recorded Grain fixtures (private/grain/observed/), plus target fields marked x-target. Known gaps: a voltage is judged against the single expected.volts value, not [min, max] (G2 -> T1: RepairOS judges the range itself); rows for an open, a pin not on the net, an unknown net or a net with no expected value carry no verdict (G22 -> T2: RepairOS derives it: continuity false + wire = open, known false = unknown_net, expected null = no_expected, a 'not on net' finding = pin_not_on_net). Grain owns the shape: additionalProperties allowed.

status.description: The worst finding severity (info counts as ok).

known.description: False: the net is not in the design.

expected.description: For a voltage reading: the net's expected value, or null when the design states none (G13).

verdict.description: Now: ok or off for a judged voltage, ok for a conducting continuity/ohms reading, absent otherwise. Target T2 adds open, pin_not_on_net, unknown_net, no_expected so every row has one; target T1 makes ok mean inside [min - tol, max + tol].

continuity.description: For a continuity or ohms reading: whether it conducts.

wire.description: For an open on a harness wire: the wire to remake (gauge, length, colour, both ends).

i.description: Target T2: index of the reading in the request.

id.description: Target T2: the request reading's id, if sent.

where.description: A net, a net with its pins in brackets, or a wire name.

reading.description: Target T2: index i of the reading this finding is about.
